name: Train carriage
desc: A moving room where strangers sit close and the view keeps changing - good for thinking, or leaving.
tags: train carriage interior, rows of seats, overhead luggage rack, hanging hand straps, carriage windows, blurred landscape through the window, sliding connecting door, floor grab poles, ceiling lights, patterned seat fabric
prose: the inside of a moving train carriage, rows of seats under luggage racks and hanging straps, blurred landscape sliding past the windows and a connecting door at the far end
note: The windows carry both the hour and the motion - a still dark window turns this into a waiting room. Commuter stock (hand straps, bench seats, standing room) and long-distance stock (facing seats, tables, big luggage rack) are two different rooms, so choose one. At night, naming the reflections in the glass does most of the mood before any grade is applied.
